content: Papuru Kerutsaremetsie kemɨretɨa
Hikɨ tewarutateutɨaka tekanekɨne, heitserie te'erietɨ kanuwa 'amɨpatsie Kuhutsi paitɨ tekaneta'axɨani, 'uxa'arieka Ruraxitsie paitɨ, manaketa Pataratsie paitɨ tekaneta'axɨani.
Mana kanuwa 'amɨpa 'ayeyeiximekame tekaniuxeiya Penitsiyatsie heyaka. Te'akayaxeka tenekɨne.
Tsipɨre kwieyari haramara hixɨapa mɨyeka te'uxeiyaka ta'utata te'uku'eirieka, Tsiriyatsie tekaneta'axɨani. Mana Tirutsie tekaniuyekɨne kanuwa 'amɨpa mana mɨti'ikapiyanikekaikɨ.
Mana teyɨ'ɨkitɨwamete tekaniwaretaxeiya, 'atahuta tukari tekaniuyurieni mɨkɨ wahamatɨa. Mɨkɨ mɨpaɨ Papuru mekateneye'eritɨani 'Iyari mɨpaɨ tiwa'ɨkitɨakaku Kerutsareme paitɨ mɨkaye'axenikɨ.

Yapaɨmexɨa tukari te'uyurieka wahamatɨa, tekanekɨne ketemɨtehukai. Yunaitɨ teyu'ɨkitɨwamete, 'ukarawetsixi meta tɨɨri mepɨtatsi'uweiyakai kiekari manu'axe paitɨ, mana haramara tetsita te'utitunuma'uka, tekaniyutanenewieni,
hikɨta tetatateutɨaxɨaka, tame kanuwa 'amɨpatsie tekanatiyaxe, mɨkɨta yukie mekaneutayeixɨani.
Tirutsie teheyekɨneka mɨkɨ kanuwa 'amɨpatsie, tawarita tekanekɨne, Turemaira tekaneta'axɨani. Mana tewarutawaɨritɨaka 'iwamarixi, xeitukari tepuyuri wahamatɨa.
Tehayekɨneka Papuru hamatɨa, 'uxa'arieka Tsetsareya tekaneta'axɨani. Peripe niuki 'aixɨa manuyɨne mukuxata hetsɨa tekaniu'axɨani, mɨkɨ xewitɨ kanihɨkɨtɨkaitɨni 'atahuta meyupaɨmetɨ memɨte'uximayakai.
Mɨkɨ yunaukame yuniwema pɨwarexeiyakai 'ɨimarixi texaxatamete.
Hikɨ yapaɨmexɨa tukari teyuriekaku, xewitɨ Kureyatsie heyeyaka mana kaninuani, Kakaɨyari niukameya 'Akawu titewatɨ.

Tahetsɨa nuaka, Papuru hɨiyameya 'utihurieka, yɨ'ɨkate meta yumamate kaniuhɨaxɨani mɨpaɨ 'utaitɨ: —'Iyari Mɨtiyupata mɨpaɨ kanaineni: “'Ikɨ hɨiyame kutsiyarieya, huriyutsixi Kerutsaremetsie mɨpaɨ mekatenihɨakuni, mɨkɨ memɨkahuriyutsixi mekaniwayetuiriekuni”.
Mɨyatete'u'enanaka, tame meta mana kiekatari wahamatɨa Papuru tekaniwawiriekaitɨni Kerutsareme mɨka'uyeyeikanikɨ.
Papuru mɨpaɨ katatiniuta'eiya: —¿Titayari xe'utitsuatɨ ne'iyari xeteweranariya? Ne nepɨha'aritsie Kerutsaremetsie nemɨhɨiyanikɨ meta nemɨmɨnikɨ Ti'aitame Ketsutsi hetsiemieme.
Yamɨkatinaki'eriekaikɨ temikununuitɨwani, tekateniuhayewa mɨpaɨ tete'ikɨhɨawetɨ: —Kamɨtsɨ yaketiuyɨni Ti'aitame kemɨtinake.
Hikɨ yapaɨmexɨa tukari 'utixɨku tetakuha'aritɨaka Kerutsaremetsie tekaneutiyune.
Hipatɨ teyu'ɨkitɨwamete Tsetsareya kiekatari tahamatɨa mepekɨ, mɨkɨ mekatanewitɨni Mɨnatsuni kie mana temukuhenikɨ, tsipɨretanaka mɨkɨ tiyɨ'ɨkitɨwame kanihɨkɨtɨkaitɨni matɨari mieme.
Papuru Kerutsaremetsie kemɨtinua
Kepauka Kerutsaremetsie temu'axɨa, 'iwamarixi mekataniutanaki'erieni meyutemamawietɨ.
'Uxa'arieka Papuru tahamatɨa kaneyani Kakuwu metahɨawekɨ, meta yunaitɨ 'ukirawetsixi mana mekaniyuxeɨriekaitɨni.
Hikɨ warutawaɨritɨaka, katiniwahekɨatɨakaitɨni naime kemɨtihɨritɨariekai hepaɨtsita Kakaɨyari kemɨtiuyuri memɨkahuriyutsixi watsata.

Mɨkɨ me'u'enanaka 'aixɨa Kakaɨyari hepaɨtsita mekaniutiyuanekaitɨni. Papuru mɨpaɨ mekateniutahɨawe: «Neuxei ta'iwama, pekaniwaxeiyani keyupaɨmetɨ miriyari huriyutsixi yuri memɨte'erie, mɨkɨ yunaitɨ yemekɨ 'inɨari niukiyaritsie mepɨtewiya.

Hikɨtsɨari, mɨpaɨ mekateni'enanaka 'ahepaɨtsita, kename mɨpaɨ peti'ɨkita Muitsexi 'inɨarieya yunaitɨ huriyutsixi meke'iku'eirieni memɨkahuriyutsixi watsata memu'uwa. Yapetiwakɨhɨawetɨ memɨka'inɨaritɨarienikɨ tɨɨri xitekiyakɨ, yuyeiyaritsie yamemɨkatekahunikɨri.
¿Keriteteyurieka? Yumɨiretɨ xɨari mepɨyukuxeɨrieni. Mepɨ'enanani pemunuakɨ.
'Ayumieme, mɨpaɨ ketineuyuri ketemɨmetetahɨawe. 'Uwa tatsata 'ukitsi yunaukatɨ mepɨye'uwa, paye'axime memeye'atɨanikɨ kememɨteyɨhɨritɨakai.

Keniwaranuwitɨki, keneu'a'itieka wahamatɨa, ketineuyutua wakɨpa mɨkaxirienikɨ 'inɨari mayanikɨ hɨritɨarika maye'akɨ. Mɨpaɨ petiyurieyu yunaitɨ mepɨtehetimani kename katiyuri kememɨtekɨhɨawarɨwa 'ahepaɨtsita, matsi 'inɨari niukiyaritsie yapetikamietɨ 'apemuyeika.

Mɨkɨtsɨ memɨkahuriyutsixi yuri memɨte'uta'eri, niuki tepɨwarenɨ'airi tewa'aitɨatɨ mɨpaɨ 'anenemetsie yamemɨkatekahunikɨ, matsi memɨka'ikwakakɨ tita tetexi memɨtexatɨarie, xuriya, tewá yukawieyu waiyarieya meta kemɨ'ane mɨkayɨ'ɨya mɨkayɨkɨna memɨkawakumaɨwanikɨ».
Hikɨ 'uxa'arieka Papuru mɨkɨ 'ukitsi kaniwarewitɨni, mɨkɨta wahamatɨa yu'itieka tukita kaneutahani, mɨpaɨ tihekɨatatɨ kename tukari 'aye'a memuyu'itienitsie, meta mɨkɨ yuxexuitɨ wamawari pɨyetuiyani.
Papuru kemɨtiuwiyarie
Kepaukari 'atahuta tukari 'aye'aximekaku, huriyutsixi 'Atsiya kiekatari Papuru tukita mekaniuxeiya. Mekaniwaruxamurieni yunaime mana memu'uwakai meta mekaniwiya,

mɨpaɨ mete'uhiwatɨ: «'Ixaheritsixi xeketaneuparewi. 'Ikɨ tewi kanihɨkɨtɨni kemɨ'ane yunaime teɨteri naitsarie 'axamɨtiwa'ɨkitɨa, 'inɨari niukiyari hepaɨtsita meta 'ena takiekaritsie. Matsi 'akuxi kɨriyekutsixi 'uwa tukita kaniwaratahatɨwani, 'ikɨ 'ena ka'akupatsiekame kanayeitɨani».
Meripaitɨri Tɨrupimu Papuru hamatɨa 'uyeikame kiekaritsie mepuxeiyakai 'epetsutanaka, tukita Papuru hetawitɨme mepɨ'eriekai.
Yunaitɨ kiekatari mepuyuxamuri. Teɨteri me'unautsaxɨaximetɨ mekaniu'axɨani, Papuru mekaniuwiya, mekanenuyehana tuki takwa, yapauka 'itupari meuwɨtsie kaneunarixɨani.
Hikɨ 'ari me'imieximekaku, kepauka niuki munua xeimiriyari kuyaxi tiwa'aitɨwame hetsɨa kename yunaitɨ Kerutsareme kiekatari meyuxamuriekai.

Kwitɨwa kuyaxi xeitsienituyari tewa'aitɨwamete yukuyaxima mewaruwitɨkɨme pɨwarewitɨ, meta mɨkɨ mana kaniutanautsa wahetsɨa. Kuyaxi tiwa'aitɨwame me'uxeiyaka meta kuyaximama, Papuru metiwayatɨ mekateniuhayewa.
'Ahurawa 'ayaka kuyaxi tiwa'aitɨwame, kaniwiya meta katiniuta'aita memihɨanikɨ huta tepɨayarikɨ. Manata kaniwaruta'iwawiya kemɨ'ane mɨhɨkɨtɨkai meta kemɨtiuyuriekai.
Hipatɨ yɨkɨ mekateniuhiwakaitɨni, hipatɨta yɨkɨ me'utiyuatɨ. 'Atsimɨkaretimaiwekaikɨ meyuxamurietɨ kememutiyuanekai kemɨ'ane yuri mutainenikeyu, 'ayumieme katiniuta'aita kuyaxi wakie memenuhanakɨ.
Kepauka Papuru 'imumuitɨa mɨye'a, peuyewekai kuyaxi me'enuyewietɨ memenuhanakɨ waɨriyarika, teɨteri memɨtsaipɨnekaikɨ.
Yumɨiretɨ mekaniweiyakaitɨni mɨpaɨ mete'uhiwatɨ: «Ke'umierieni».
Papuru yuhetsiemieme teɨteri wahɨxie kemɨtiutaniu

Hikɨ kepauka kuyaxi wakiita meheitahatɨaximekaku, Papuru kuyaxi tiwa'aitɨwame mɨpaɨ katiniuta'iwawiya: —Pekanetipitɨa nemɨmetitaxatɨanikɨ. Mɨkɨ mɨpaɨ katinita'eiya: —'Ekɨ kuta kɨriyekutsixi waniukikɨ petiniuwe.
¿Mɨkɨ 'ekipitutanaka pekatihɨkɨ meripaitɨ kuya pematɨa, meta makumawetsie nauka miiriyari yukukuyamete pemɨwarewitɨ?

Papuru mɨpaɨ katinita'eiya: —Netsɨ nekanihuriyutɨni, Tarutsu nepɨnuiwakame Tsiritsiya kwieyaritsie nemiemetɨtɨ, kiekari 'amɨyewatsie nekanikiekametɨni. Hikɨ nepɨmatsiwawirie, keneneupitɨa teɨteri nemɨtiwataxatɨanikɨ.
Kuyaxi tiwa'aitɨwame 'ipitɨaku, Papuru 'imumuitsie 'utiwetɨ teɨteri yumamakɨ kaniwaru'inɨaritɨani. Kepauka yunaitɨ kayuwatɨ me'utamareku, 'arameu niukiyarikɨ kaniutaniuni, mɨpaɨ 'utaitɨ:
